lines.text: The burnt offering stays on the altar hearth all night, and the priest carries the ashes outside the camp.
The priest burns a handful of the grain offering on the altar, and Aaron and his sons eat the rest.
The clay pot in which the sin offering is boiled must be broken.
A thanksgiving peace offering must be eaten the day offered, and meat left until the fifth day is burned.
The LORD gave Moses these offering laws on Mount Horeb on the day He commanded Israel to present their offerings.
